question: Why should I choose an ice cream bike instead of a classic ice cream truck?
answer: An ice cream bike is the perfect choice if space at your location is limited or if you want to serve ice cream directly inside a building. It exudes a very special, nostalgic charm and, due to its compact size, often appears more approachable to guests. Furthermore, it is 100% emission-free and extremely quiet, as no disturbing motor runs during operation. For events in narrow backyards or directly in conference rooms, the bike is therefore functionally superior to our large van.

question: Does Nicezeit also offer the ice cream bike at trade fairs in Hanover?
answer: Yes, our mobile ice cream bikes are an absolute crowd-puller at the entire Hanover exhibition grounds. With their appealing design, they specifically attract walk-in customers to your stand and offer an informal way to start conversations with potential clients. A delicious ice cream usually breaks the proverbial "ice" in business contacts in a matter of seconds.

question: Can the ice cream bike be branded with a company logo?
answer: Absolutely! The front box of the bicycle offers nice smooth surfaces that we are happy to customize to your corporate design with individual foils or magnetic signs. Color-matched napkins or ice cream cups with your printed logo are also easily realizable. This turns the historic bike into an innovative and delicious advertising medium for your company.

question: Is an ice cream bike more environmentally friendly than an ice cream truck?
answer: Definitely, because the ice cream bike cools the varieties autonomously using special cold plates, without the need for an internal combustion engine to run or exhaust gases to be produced. Together with our biodegradable cups and edible cones, this is the most sustainable way to enhance your event in Hanover culinarily.

question: Who operates the ice cream bike at my party?
answer: Even when booking our compact ice cream bike, at least one professional Nicezeit employee is always on site. This person takes care of the hygienically perfect portioning, serving to guests, and continuously keeps the work area clean. So you can fully relax and enjoy your celebration as a host.

question: How long does the ice cream stay cold in the bike, even in midsummer?
answer: Thanks to excellent insulation and powerful eutectic cooling plates, the temperature in the ice cream box remains constant at the perfect level for six to eight hours. Even at outdoor temperatures of over 30 degrees in the shade, you don't have to worry about unsightly melting ice cream. Your guests will be served absolute premium quality from the first to the last scoop.

question: Can I also rent the ice cream bike for private garden parties in narrow backyards?
answer: That's exactly what the ice cream bike was originally designed for! Unlike the large delivery van, it can be easily pushed through normal garden gates and finds space even in the smallest corner of your property. As long as access to the garden does not have steep stairs or extremely soft ground, we will maneuver the bike directly to your party guests.

question: Are vegan ice cream flavors available for the bike?
answer: Of course, you can freely choose the flavors for the ice cream bike from our current, large selection. This always includes wonderfully fruity, purely vegan sorbets or delicious vegan oat-based milk ice cream alternatives. This way, you can easily ensure that guests with lactose intolerance or a vegan lifestyle also get their money's worth.

question: What happens to the ice cream bike if it rains during an outdoor event?
answer: We standardly bring a beautiful, matching parasol that not only provides pleasant shade but also protects the bike and our ice cream vendor from light summer drizzle. In case of heavier storms, however, we recommend simply pushing the compact bike under a tent, an awning, or directly indoors to a dry place. This incredible flexibility is precisely what makes the bike so weather-independent for any type of event.

question: Can I book the ice cream bike for a wedding at Steinhuder Meer?
answer: Yes, we transport our ice cream bikes with our fleet even beyond the direct city limits of Hanover. Steinhuder Meer is a beautiful setting for festive weddings, and we are very happy to supply the event locations there with our bikes. For such slightly longer distances, we only charge a transparent and fair, distance-dependent flat rate for travel.
